summary: Bind Fractal composer submissions and retries to their original session and draft revision, upload native image attachments, and retain editable drafts through explicit offline and authorization recovery.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Fractal web captures session-bound outbox payloads and attachment identities. Composer availability distinguishes offline transport, missing grants and revoked authorization. Recovery never automatically resends. No storage schema, checkpoint, CLI or harness protocol change.
